mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the historical average by more than 1%, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds the historical average by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.3% and PAYEMS decrease > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both UNRATE increases by more than 0.3% and PAYEMS decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO declines by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a monetary tightening in a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 0.5% and GDPC1 decline > 0.5% in 3 months
regime_hint: monetary tightening in a weakening economy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% and GDPC1 declines by more than 0.5% over three months.
